title: Levers in the body
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:35Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, hms-force-levers, covers the bone-as-lever, joint-as-fulcrum and muscle-as-effort basics, but its main content is about force and speed at release, and it does not teach lever systems, so it is broader or different from this point.

draft.title: Levers in the body
card: A lever is a rigid bar that turns around a fixed point to move a load. In the body, bones are the levers.
the fixed point the lever turns around. In the body, a joint is the axis.
the effort that moves the lever. In the body, a muscle pulls on a bone through its tendon to provide it.
the resistance being moved, such as the weight of a body part or an object held in the hand.
draft.remember: Bone is the lever, joint is the axis, muscle is the force.

a.q: In a bicep curl, which part of the body acts as the axis of the lever?
a.why: The axis is the fixed point the lever turns around, which is the joint. The forearm bone is the lever, and the biceps provides the force. The weight is the load.
a.clue: The axis is the point the bone turns around.

b.q: Priya kicks a football. Her quadriceps pull on her shin bone, which swings about her knee. Which row matches the lever parts?
opts: Shin is the lever, knee is the axis, quadriceps give force
Knee is the lever, shin is the axis, quadriceps give force
Shin is the lever, quadriceps are the axis, knee gives force
Quadriceps are the lever, knee is the axis, shin gives force
b.why: The shin bone is the rigid lever, and it turns about the knee joint, the axis. The quadriceps pull on it to give the force. The muscle is not the lever, because muscles pull and bones are the rigid bars.
b.clue: Which part is the bone, which is the joint, and which pulls?

b.best: Shin is the lever, knee is the axis, quadriceps give force
